Lady Gaga and her fiancé Michael Polansky have welcomed their first baby together, according to a source cited by PEOPLE. The news marks an important personal milestone for Gaga, who has spoken publicly for years about her hopes of becoming a mother. She has discussed motherhood in interviews and described having children as part of her hopes for the future. In 2025, she also referred to motherhood as a hoped-for “next starring role.”
Gaga and Polansky began their relationship around 2020 and became engaged in 2024. The couple has generally kept their relationship private while supporting each other’s careers and charitable work.
The report does not disclose the baby’s name, sex, exact birth date, or other private details. The pregnancy and birth should therefore be reported carefully without adding unconfirmed information
